subject: checking in
body:
Good morning,
 
I am writing to ask about where we are in the process of programming the Stroop and obtaining API information from BACtrack Skyn. Are you currently waiting for me to send/do something, or am I currently waiting for you?
 
Our first study (ID: 3791) seems to be going well so far. Our second study (ID: 3942) will need these programming options completed. We are hoping to start recruiting this fall, so any updates about timelines would be greatly appreciated!
 
Also, my project manager, Suri, will be leaving us. It appears that she is listed as the "owner" for both of these studies, whereas I am listed as a "permission manager." Is this something she is able to update on her end, or do I need to have someone at Avicenna fix it? We will have to remove her researcher account from our Avicenna profile soon so that we can ad her replacement when hired.
 
Thank you!
